summary: Recent changes to the 2D graphics library in Firefox focused on improving the accuracy of the unpremultiplied alpha blending process. The update ensures that the Unpremultiply_SSE2 function, which utilizes Intel's SIMD (Single Instruction, Multiple Data) technology, now produces results that are **bit-exact** to those generated by the scalar and NEON (used for ARM processors) versions. This matters because maintaining fidelity in how graphics are rendered can lead to better visual quality and consistency across different hardware, ensuring that images look the same regardless of where they're displayed.
